subject: Formal School Committee Rules Adoption
overview: The Committee formally adopted its first set of written operating rules and received reports on mental health staffing and the high school renovation application process. Discussions also covered the fiscal year 2023 budget timeline and district-wide student assessment data.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from March 7 and March 9, 2022.

items.title: Superintendent Updates
items.summary: The Superintendent provided updates on Down Syndrome awareness, student athletic and artistic achievements, and solidarity efforts for Ukraine.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2023 Budget Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy outlined a condensed two-day public hearing schedule focused on equity, technology, organizational structure, and federal funding.

items.title: Report on Mental Health Supports
items.summary: Staff presented data on counseling caseloads and the Care Solace referral system, noting that the district currently maintains no waitlists for in-school counseling.

items.title: Athletic User Fees Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Cushing reported on mid-year fee collections and discussed the possibility of implementing universal user fees for all extracurricular activities.

items.title: MSBA Application Process Update
items.summary: The district announced it will submit a Statement of Interest for the MSBA Core Program to address infrastructure needs at Medford High School.

items.title: Formal Adoption of Committee Rules
items.summary: Approved the first formal set of written rules for the committee, including an amendment to establish a public tracking system for all action items and resolutions.

items.title: Communicable Diseases Policy Review
items.summary: Referred the review and update of the communicable diseases policy to the Rules and Policy subcommittee.

items.title: NWEA MAP Assessment Implementation Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a detailed report on how teachers use MAP testing data to inform instruction, with results due by June 6.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The meeting adjourned after recognizing the passing of several former educators and community members.
